ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 rider cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher; record the driver's premature no-show cancellation against his no-show record; no account flag on this case.

rejected_claims.reason: Proximity is accepted but does not establish NS-1: the same record shows only 2 min 50 s inside the 200 m zone (F2), which is less than the >180 s required by NS-1(iii) [F2][NS-1].
The stationary period relied on is 2 min 5 s (F3), shorter still than the >180 s wait required by NS-1(iii), so it confirms the shortfall [F3][NS-1].

Sending the 'I'm here' message at 21:29 (F10) does not replace the required waiting period; cancellation followed at 21:30:55 with only 2 min 50 s inside the radius per the system records (F4, F5), failing NS-1(iii) [F4][F5][NS-1].

The driver's account of waiting is contradicted by the timeline (21:26:00 acceptance, 21:30:55 cancellation) and the 2 min 50 s inside the pickup zone (F12, F4, F2); system records govern over statements under NS-1 [F2][F4][F12][NS-1].
That $6.61 is the published, non-surged fee (F8, F9) is irrelevant: the fee is chargeable only if NS-1 is satisfied, and it is not, so NS-2 mandates a full refund [F8][NS-1][NS-2].
The absence of traffic or weather events (F13, F14, F15) is not an element of NS-1 and provides no justification for cancelling before the 3-minute wait threshold was met [F13][F14][NS-1].

The rider's request for an account-review flag based on the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes (F17) is declined: NS-2's flag applies only where the driver tapped 'I'm Here' while not at the pickup, which is not the case here (F6 shows the tap at 42 m) [F6][F17][NS-2].
